The '''2014 Rosemount Championship''' (RMC) was the yearly championship of the Rosemount, Minnesota school Star Wars CCG community built by [[Mark Walseth]], held on 14 June 2014. 26 players entered. [[Jake Nelson]] won his first RMC title, beating Mitch 2–0 in the final.<ref name="rmc14">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=54746 Rosemount Championship 2014 (RMC)], forum.starwarsccg.org (19 May – 16 June 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004523/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t54746.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Rosemount, Minnesota<ref name="rmc14" />
* '''Date:''' 14 June 2014<ref name="rmc14" />
* '''Structure:''' Swiss rounds, then a top-4 single elimination with a two-game final<ref name="rmc14" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="rmc14" />
* '''Field:''' 26 players<ref name="rmc14" />

In the semi-finals Mitch played Bryan and Jake played Conrad. Jake won both games of the final against Mitch, the first by 21. The first Rosemount Jedi Award, chosen by the organizer with the 8th-grade players, went to [[Sam Olson|Sam O]]. Prizes included a bye to Day 2 of Worlds, a Virtual card donated by the Players Committee and 30 packs of Reflections III.<ref name="rmc14" />
